ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ الَّذِيْ جَاءَ بِالْأٓيَاتِ الْبَيِّنَاتِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Alladhī jā’a bi ‘l-āyāti ‘l-bayyināt.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the one who came with indisputable verses!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ الْمُؤَيَّدِ بِجَلَائِلِ الْمُعْجِزَاتِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, al-Mu’ayyadi bi jalā’ili ‘l-mu`jizāt.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the supported by immense miracles!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ الْقَائِلِ إِنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, al-Qā’ili innama ‘l-a‘mālu bi ‘n-niyyāt.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the coiner of “Deeds are but by intention”.
